thread:
Zoe: quick triage follow-up from the streaming postmortem. need compact owners, short verification plan, and a single place to track progress. posting the short summary here and moving action items to the remediation board after we confirm owners.

Marco: I'll take the server-side serialization/chunk boundary bug. initial hypothesis: race between flush and ordered kv-evict callbacks. will add a repro harness + a guarded flush that defers final chunk if eviction pending. ETA: prototype in 4 days, canary in 12.

Lina: I'll pick up client reconnect/backoff changes and a defensive handshake clamp. plan: implement capped full-jitter backoff + emit reconnect_reason in telemetry. prototype 5 days, staged rollout 3w.

Ravi: I'll own verification + canary orchestration. plan: 3-day canary with automatic metric comparison and rollback hook. need per-request partial flag and a synthetic stream generator from four regions.

Zoe: nice. let's codify action items (short ids) so infra can pick them up:
- SR-101: Add "partial_flag" to streaming responses + per-request telemetry (request_id, route, model). owner: Zoe. due: 2026-04-01.
- SR-102: Repro harness + unit/integration tests for mid-stream kv-eviction. owner: Marco. due: 2026-03-30.
- SR-103: Safe-chunk flush + guarded serialization path. owner: Marco. due: 2026-04-10.
- SR-104: Client lib: capped exponential backoff with full jitter + handshake clamp + reconnect_reason telemetry. owner: Lina. due: 2026-04-03.
- SR-105: Synthetic hourly stream from 4 regions (lightweight) + weekly digest to #eng-runtime. owner: Ravi. due: 2026-03-29.
- SR-106: Canary orchestration + automatic rollback criteria (partial_ratio delta > 25% OR p99 latency +40%). owner: Ravi & infra. due: 2026-04-14.

Marco: implementation note for SR-103  we can avoid a global lock by using per-stream fencing tokens. will measure impact on p95/p99.

Lina: for SR-104 i'll add an opt-in client flag so existing users are not forced into new backoff behavior immediately. will also add a debug endpoint to trigger reconnect sequences for QA.

Zoe: monitoring thresholds proposal: create two alerts
- A1 (warning): partial_ratio > 0.15% for 10m -> notify channel #incidents
- A2 (page): partial_ratio > 0.5% for 5m OR synthetic stream fail > 2 runs -> page oncall

Please comment if you think thresholds should be different.

Ravi: infra request: ops-bot, please create INFRA ticket to wire the rollback hook into canary automation and ensure we have a quick toggle to disable safe-chunk.

ops-bot: created ticket INFRA-735 and assigned to infra-oncall. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INFRA-735

Marco: risk note: guarded flush may add up to ~40ms per final-chunk in worst-case. we'll measure across payload sizes and include p50/p95/p99 in canary report. rollback plan: flip feature-flag off and revert PR if partial_ratio worsens. document exact PR revert steps in remediation ticket.

Lina: telemetry detail: reconnect_reason will be one of {"handshake_timeout","network_error","server_close","client_kill"}. will also emit reconnect_attempt_count and time_since_last_reconnect.

Zoe: good. Ravi please add a simple smoke checklist for canary days: (1) verify synthetic streams from 4 regions ok, (2) check partial_ratio and reconnect_count, (3) validate p99 not regressing beyond threshold.

Ravi: will do. scheduling note: weekly remediation sync Thursdays 09:00 PST. pager-bot: please add recurring reminder and attach remediation board link.

pager-bot: scheduled "Streaming reliability remediation" every Thu 09:00 PST starting 2026-03-26. board link: https://redwood.internal/remediations/1967890123

Zoe: ownership recap: Zoe (telemetry + alerts SR-101), Marco (server chunking SR-102/SR-103), Lina (client SR-104), Ravi (synthetic + canary SR-105/SR-106). next sync: 2026-03-26 09:00 PST. please update each SR- ticket with status and blockers before meeting.

Marco: i'll open the repro PR today and tag Lina for client-side interplay review.

Lina: will review and add client-side tests for handshake edgecases.

Zoe: closing thread for now  will reopen if new data. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
